claims.explanation: The drug BNTX, annotated as an opioid receptor antagonist, likely kills cancer cells through off-target inhibition of the ubiquitin-proteasome system, as suggested by its transcriptional similarity to proteasome inhibitors and its disruption of the actin network. Sensitivity is strongly associated with TP53 mutations, which may impair the DNA damage response and apoptosis, and with mutations in FBXW7, a component of the SCF ubiquitin ligase complex, potentially creating a dependency on proteasome function. Lineages such as lung, gastric, and melanoma are enriched among sensitive lines, while kidney and some breast cancers are less affected, possibly due to alternative survival pathways.

features.basis: Observed pattern: TP53 mutations are highly enriched in sensitive lines (e.g., SNU685, NCIH1648, HGC27) and less common in resistant lines.
Observed pattern: FBXW7 mutations appear in multiple sensitive lines (NCIH1648, MKN1, CL11, SNUC5) but not in resistant lines.
Observed pattern: BRAF mutations are present in several sensitive melanoma and colorectal lines (K029AX, LOXIMVI, UACC62, SNUC5).
Observed pattern: KRAS mutations are found in sensitive lines (CL11, GSU, T3M4) but also in some resistant lines, suggesting a context-dependent effect.
Observed pattern: PTEN mutations are more frequent in resistant lines (786O, ZR751, KALS1, HEC265) than in sensitive lines.
Observed pattern: EGFR mutations appear in resistant lung lines (HCC4006, KYSE270) and one sensitive line (NCIH1650), suggesting a protective trend.
Observed pattern: ATM mutations are present in sensitive lines (SNU685, SNUC5) but also in resistant lines (786O), weak evidence.
Observed pattern: CDKN2A mutations appear in several sensitive lines (K029AX, MHHES1, IPC298) but also in one resistant line (SNU1214).
Observed pattern: PIK3CA mutations are found in sensitive lines (HGC27, MKN1, SNUC5, KYSE510) but also in resistant lines (SNU840).
Observed pattern: NF1 mutations appear in sensitive lines (S117, FTC133, LOXIMVI) but also in resistant lines (BICR6, KALS1).
Observed pattern: ARID1A mutations are present in sensitive lines (LOXIMVI, SNUC5) but also in resistant lines (HEC265, KU1919).
Observed pattern: KMT2D mutations are more frequent in resistant lines (BICR6, KYSE270, HEC265, KU1919, KE39) than in sensitive lines.
